newsitem.title: CHINA: Trading in Styland shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading in Styland shares suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of electronics firm Styland Holdings Ltd was suspended on Thursday afternoon at the direction of the Securities & Futures Commission, the Hong Kong stock exchange said.
The company's shares rose HK$0.035 to HK$0.37 at midday. Volume was 304.43 million shares worth HK$111.43 million.

Styland said earlier on Thursday it was not aware of any reason for the recent increase in price and turnover of its shares and confirmed no price sensitive negotiations or agreements in relation to any acquisitions or disposal were underway.
